title: Follow-ups of ci-matrix: CI case subsets, dispatch base input, pipeline gate and worker environment, orca-wait stall

tasks.objective: Plan ci-matrix follow-ups 1 and 2 (docs/plans/ci-matrix/report.md 'Follow-ups'). (1) The CI suite job runs every case of a selected suite because 'tests/run-all.sh --only-suites' has no case subset; scripts/ci-plan.py already plans 'cases' (ALL or a comma list from tests/affected.py). Add a run-all option that gives one --only-suites suite a case subset (for example '--only-cases A,B', valid only with exactly one --only-suites name and a suite that has a case map; it passes --case A,B to that suite exactly as --affected does today; ALL or an empty value runs every case), reuse the existing --case plumbing of the affected path, and keep the rule that case subsets never publish suite PASS records. Pass the planned cases from .github/workflows/tests.yml (only when not ALL) and drop the comment that says the subset is ignored. (2) workflow_dispatch full=false has no base, so it plans every suite: add a 'base' input (a ref or sha, default empty) used when full is false, with ci-plan.py's existing fail-safe (no or unusable base plans every suite). Tests: tests/run-all-parallel.test.sh cases for the new option (subset reaches the suite as --case, ALL runs all, misuse exits 2, no PASS record for a subset); tests/ci-plan.test.sh only if ci-plan.py changes. Update tests/README.md (CI section, the option) and add changelog.d/ci-cases.md (### Changed).
acceptance: a suite with a case map runs only the planned cases in CI, and ALL runs every case
workflow_dispatch full=false with a base plans only the affected suites
case subsets publish no suite PASS record

tasks.objective: Plan ci-matrix follow-ups 3, 5, 6 and 8 (docs/plans/ci-matrix/report.md 'Follow-ups'), all in scripts/factory-pipeline.py and tests/pipeline.test.sh. (3) tests/pipeline.test.sh asserts only the integration QA clause of the CI wording; add an assertion for the task QA clause the verify and QA specs print. (5) Worker sessions on Windows failed live suites because RPG_FACTORY_WORKSPACE was unset in the worker: when the run lead's environment sets RPG_FACTORY_WORKSPACE, the dispatched implement, verify and QA specs carry it as an instruction to set it for every test run (no change when it is unset). (6) pp_spec in tests/pipeline.test.sh shlex-splits combined stdout and stderr, so any quote character in a dispatch stderr line breaks it: make pp_spec parse only the command line it needs (the orca or agent line) so stderr text cannot break it, and keep the existing cases green. (8) delivery.md section 8 says follow-ups go to docs/plans/backlog.md in the integration commit, but gate counts a run lead's backlog.md change as outside every task's owned paths: treat docs/plans/backlog.md like the plan file and its report.md (never stray) and cover it with a gate case. Changelog fragment changelog.d/pipeline-followups.md (### Fixed).
acceptance: gate does not block a run lead's docs/plans/backlog.md change
a dispatch stderr line with a quote character no longer breaks pp_spec
specs carry RPG_FACTORY_WORKSPACE when the run lead has it set

tasks.objective: Plan ci-matrix follow-up 7: scripts/orca-wait.sh --stall-ms 0 reports an immediate stall instead of disabling the stall check. Make 0 disable it (as --stall-poll-ms 0 presumably does; check), state that in the usage line, add a case to tests/orca-wait.test.sh, and add changelog.d/orca-wait-stall.md (### Fixed).
